basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast and a father of three, trying to navigate the world of cryptocurrency for my family's future. I recently moved to the Richmond, VA area. I'm still getting used to Reddit and mainly browse during evenings after work as a software developer. I enjoy playing Magic: The Gathering and have been learning about Danish culture for an upcoming trip. I'm married and enjoy spending weekends exploring local parks with my family.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in software development, with a degree in Computer Science. I am self-teaching about cryptocurrencies and blockchain technology. I often consult online forums and resources to expand my knowledge.
